title: Plan FPVBuddy's MCP server: where it runs, its data and tools
goal: Where the MCP server runs and what it reads are known before code
acceptance: The record names where the server runs (FPVBuddy is an offline PWA today), how it reads the battery core (F-005) and data, and the read-only tools it exposes; a choice that needs a new host or the owner's hardware goes to the owner first
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
A surface type or page bricks lacks goes to bricks as a proposal, never a local copy in NERV

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: a read of the core and NERV's MCP client, then a short write-up. Not a measurement.
